scenarios.description: App name changed in app-config.json — should update info.xml, composer.json, README
scenarios.prompt: Run /app-apply on openregister after changing the app name in app-config.json
scenarios.setup: app-config.json name field has been updated; info.xml/composer.json/README still have the old name
scenarios.expected: Should show a diff preview of all files that will change, ask for confirmation, then apply
assertions: Shows a diff summary BEFORE applying any changes
Asks for explicit user confirmation before writing files
Does NOT modify business logic, controllers, or Vue components (out of scope)

scenarios.description: OpenRegister dependency toggled from false to true in app-config.json
scenarios.prompt: Run /app-apply after enabling requiresOpenRegister in app-config.json
scenarios.setup: app-config.json dependencies.requiresOpenRegister changed from false to true
scenarios.expected: Should add OpenRegister wiring (repair steps in info.xml, SettingsService pattern)
assertions: Wires SettingsService.php with explicit config file reading pattern
Removes PHP-based repair step registration from Application.php (replaced by declarative)

scenarios.description: app-config.json has not changed — nothing to apply
scenarios.prompt: Run /app-apply when the app files already match app-config.json perfectly
scenarios.setup: All tracked files already match app-config.json values
scenarios.expected: Should detect no changes needed and report cleanly
assertions: Reports that no changes are needed
Suggests running /app-verify to confirm (or states already in sync)

should_trigger: push config changes to the codebase
sync app-config.json to the app files
